title: Shopify pet-products dropshipping store, TikTok ads (US)

source.text: A Shopify dropshipping store selling pet products advertised on TikTok. Launch country US, budget $1,500, 15 hours a week, goal side income, no special edge. Just go: do not ask questions.

solution: A Shopify dropshipping store selling pet products
assumptions: Average order $34.99, one item per order (no price given)
Products sourced from CJdropshipping US warehouse to avoid China shipping times
Customer: US dog and cat owners reached through TikTok ads
About $600/month of the $1,500 goes to ads; the rest to store, apps and samples
